mostWorthwhile.text: Filtering the blood sample was most worthwhile because it showed that water and small dissolved substances enter the tubule while blood cells and most proteins stay in the blood. That made the later recovery steps meaningful.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the ureters and bladder was predictable from the named slots, though the resulting explanation clarified their route.

surprise.text: The statement that healthy kidneys normally recover almost all filtered glucose made the scale of nutrient recovery clearer.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The item descriptions made the sequence reasonably clear, although I was following the available components rather than deciding how kidney transport works in detail.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter: connecting the kidneys to the body's circulation was satisfying, and I am curious how another system would fit into the model. The mostly predictable assembly steps would make me less interested if the same pattern continued for too long.
